Mac mini rental in California: a dedicated hosted Mac for Claude Code, Codex and Xcode

Reviewed: 2026-11-20 · WodeMac

WodeMac rents physical M6 Mac minis hosted in California. Each machine goes to one customer, stays online 24/7, ships with Claude Code, Codex and a remote desktop app preinstalled, and gives you admin rights. Plans run from $169 a month to $1,723.80 a year, paid upfront for the machine only. Your Claude and OpenAI accounts, subscriptions and usage stay separate and stay yours. Delivery is usually within 24 hours and no later than 3 business days.

A whole machine, not a shared VM

Each Mac mini is rented to a single customer and is not split between customers. You reach it through the preinstalled WodeMac Remote Screen app, install whatever your project needs with admin rights, and can order several for a team. The current machine is an M6 Mac mini with a 12-core CPU, 16GB memory and 256GB storage.

Dedicated does not mean nobody else can ever reach it: WodeMac and the hosting provider keep administrative access for maintenance and troubleshooting. Before putting customer code, secrets or business data on it, agree on access, backups and what happens to the data when the rental ends.

What people use it for

  • A hosted Mac for Claude Code or Codex that keeps working after you close your laptop.
  • Building and testing iOS and Mac apps with Xcode when your own computer runs Windows or Linux.
  • Long builds, test suites, automation scripts and scheduled jobs that need a machine which never sleeps.
  • One machine per developer for a team, so tasks, accounts and permissions stay apart.

The service covers software development and testing. A Mac in California is not a substitute for eligibility: Claude Code and Codex run on your own or your company's accounts, under each provider's rules on regions, age, payment and use.

Checklist before you order

  1. Pick one real development task and decide who signs it off.
  2. Check that the CPU, memory, disk, macOS version and dependencies fit that project.
  3. Try the remote connection from your own network; latency to California depends on where you are.
  4. Confirm your Claude, OpenAI or other tool accounts, subscriptions and eligibility.
  5. Check the charge, billing start, delivery time, renewal and refund terms.
  6. Decide how code, permissions, backups and end-of-rental data are handled.

Delivery is usually within 24 hours and no later than 3 business days, and billing starts on the day of payment. A submitted order is not a payment or a delivery; the current order page and terms take precedence.

FAQ

Does the rental include a Claude or ChatGPT subscription?

No. The price covers the machine only. You sign in to Claude Code and Codex with your own accounts and pay the providers directly.

Is the Mac shared with other customers?

No. Each physical Mac mini is rented to one customer. WodeMac and the hosting provider keep admin access for maintenance.

How fast is delivery?

Usually within 24 hours, and no later than 3 business days after payment.

Can I start with one Mac?

Yes. Start with one machine and one real task, check the setup and connection, then add more for the team if it works.
